rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Code Auditor creates a searchable index of codebases, enabling analysis of code patterns, quality issues, and architectural violations. Detects SOLID principle violations, code duplication, security vulnerabilities, and provides dependency mapping. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, and Go with AST-based analysis and fast in-memory searching.
